# Scholastic

> Scholastic is the leading K-12 education company providing books, literacy programs, classroom resources, and educational solutions for teachers, parents, and students.

Scholastic offers a comprehensive ecosystem of products and services including book clubs, classroom libraries, curriculum-aligned magazines, fundraising programs, and streaming educational content. The platform serves teachers, parents, and schools with PreK-Grade 12 literacy development and learning resources.

## Key Topics

- Scholastic Book Clubs
- Scholastic Education
- Scholastic Magazines+
- Classroom libraries

- Diversity collections
- Social-emotional learning

## Core Shopping & Products

- [Scholastic Homepage](https://www.scholastic.com): Main Scholastic homepage with books, learning resources, and educational solutions for literacy development.
- [Scholastic Book Clubs](https://clubs.scholastic.com): Book club product page for children's books and classroom campaigns for families and teachers.
- [Scholastic Education Teacher Shop](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/tsohomepage.html): Teacher shop for books, classroom libraries, and instructional programs.
- [Scholastic Parent Store](https://shop.scholastic.com/parent-ecommerce/parent-store.html): Parent shopping destination for children's books and reading resources.
- [New Releases](https://shop.scholastic.com/parent-ecommerce/featured-shops/new-releases.html): New releases and hot off the press children's books from Scholastic.
- [Scholastic eGift Cards](https://shop.scholastic.com/giftcard/purchase): Digital gift cards for instant delivery to teachers and families.

## Classroom Collections & Libraries

- [Collections and Libraries](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/books-and-magazines/collections-and-libraries.html): Curated classroom book collections and libraries with diversity and social-emotional learning focus.
- [Best New Books Collection](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/shops/best-new-books-collection.html): Best new books collection for teachers and classroom libraries.
- [Diversity Collections](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/shops/diversity-collections.html): Diversity book collections for building inclusive classroom libraries.
- [Social and Emotional Collections](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/shops/social-and-emotional-collections.html): Social-emotional learning book collections supporting student well-being and development.
- [Bilingual & Spanish Collections](https://shop.scholastic.com/teachers-ecommerce/teacher/shops/bilingual-spanish-collection.html): Bilingual and Spanish language books for multilingual classroom learning.

## Educational Programs & Content

- [Scholastic Education Solutions](https://education.scholastic.com/educationsolutions/home.html): Literacy programs and reading curriculum aligned to standards for PreK-12.
- [Scholastic Magazines+](https://classroommagazines.scholastic.com): Curriculum-aligned digital magazine content for PreK through Grade 12.
- [ScholasticTV](https://www.scholastic.com/site/ScholasticTV.html): Streaming service providing educational kids' entertainment and learning content.
- [ClassroomsCount Fundraising](https://education.scholastic.com/education/classroomscount/raise-classroom-funds.html): Fundraising program helping teachers raise classroom funding and resources.

## Book Fairs & Catalogs

- [Scholastic Book Fair](https://bookfairs.scholastic.com/content/fairs/home.html): Book fair platform for school registration and event scheduling.
- [Trade Publishing Catalog](https://tradecatalog.scholastic.com): Scholastic trade publishing catalog for browsing and searching books.
